ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AD$ is the altitude of $\triangle ABC$ on side $BC$, $AE$ bisects $\angle BAC$. Given that $\angle B=40^\circ$, $\angle C=72^\circ$, find the measures of $\angle AEC$ and $\angle DAE$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because \angle BAC + \angle B + \angle C = 180^\circ$, $\angle B = 40^\circ$, $\angle C = 72^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle BAC = 68^\circ$,\\
$\because$ AE bisects $\angle BAC$,\\
$\therefore \angle BAE = \angle CAE = \frac{1}{2} \angle BAC = 34^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle AEC = \angle B + \angle BAE = 74^\circ$,\\
$\because$ AD$\perp$BC,\\
$\therefore \angle ADE = 90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle DAE = 90^\circ - \angle AEC = \boxed{16^\circ}$.
